A '''bone stabilizer''' was a medical tool found in some [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. Bone stabilizers were used to immobilize broken [[Bone/Legends|bones]], where they were then protected by [[Spray splint/Legends|spray splints]]. Once transferred to a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]], the bones could then be repaired by a [[bone-knitter]].

==Description==
Bone stabilizers were included in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], including [[BioTech Industries/Legends|Biotech Industries']] [[FastFlesh medpac/Legends|FastFlesh medpac]]<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[Ula Vii]] used a bone stabilizer, along with a [[laser cauterizer]], to treat [[Larin Moxla]] when the latter had four fingers severed by a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>
